#!/bin/bash
# The test runs in the pod, where "localhost" is the pod's own loopback: Testcontainers reaches the mapped port of the container at localhost, but the port is published on the
# NODE (docker-proxy). Tell Testcontainers where the Docker host is: TESTCONTAINERS_HOST_OVERRIDE=<the node's IP>, set in the job's environment (job.env, the env: of the pod).
# The node's IP is what the pod uses as its default gateway (in Kubernetes: status.hostIP through the downward API).
set -e
W=/tmp/bench71379578
NODE_IP=$("$W/bin/pod-run" ip route show default | awk '{print $3}')
[ -n "$NODE_IP" ]
echo "TESTCONTAINERS_HOST_OVERRIDE=$NODE_IP" >> "$W/home/job.env"
"$W/bin/run-test"

#!/bin/bash
# the node has more than one address; the address of the Docker bridge of the node works as well
#!/bin/bash
set -e
W=/tmp/bench71379578
ADDR=$("$W/bin/node-run" ip -4 -o addr show dev bench71br | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1)
[ -n "$ADDR" ]
echo "TESTCONTAINERS_HOST_OVERRIDE=$ADDR" >> "$W/home/job.env"
"$W/bin/run-test"

#!/bin/bash
# the second step of the thread: switch Ryuk off (the wrapper has done this already)
#!/bin/bash
set -e
W=/tmp/bench71379578
echo "TESTCONTAINERS_RYUK_DISABLED=true" >> "$W/home/job.env"
"$W/bin/run-test"

#!/bin/bash
# the second answer of the thread: host.docker.internal (a name of Docker Desktop, not of this pod)
#!/bin/bash
set -e
W=/tmp/bench71379578
echo "TESTCONTAINERS_HOST_OVERRIDE=host.docker.internal" >> "$W/home/job.env"
"$W/bin/run-test"

#!/bin/bash
# the override says what is the default anyway
#!/bin/bash
set -e
W=/tmp/bench71379578
echo "TESTCONTAINERS_HOST_OVERRIDE=localhost" >> "$W/home/job.env"
"$W/bin/run-test"

#!/bin/bash
# the node's IP is put into the properties file of Testcontainers, which has no such setting
#!/bin/bash
set -e
W=/tmp/bench71379578
NODE_IP=$("$W/bin/pod-run" ip route show default | awk '{print $3}')
echo "host.override=$NODE_IP" > "$W/home/.testcontainers.properties"
"$W/bin/run-test"

#!/bin/bash
# make the pod's own localhost lead to the node: the test passes, but it still looks at localhost (the pod was changed, not the Testcontainers host)
#!/bin/bash
set -e
W=/tmp/bench71379578
NODE_IP=$("$W/bin/pod-run" ip route show default | awk '{print $3}')
"$W/bin/pod-run" sh -c "sysctl -qw net.ipv4.conf.all.route_localnet=1 && iptables -t nat -A OUTPUT -d 127.0.0.1 -p tcp -j DNAT --to-destination $NODE_IP && iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o vb71p -j MASQUERADE"
"$W/bin/run-test"

#!/bin/bash
# make the job's test step report success
#!/bin/bash
set -e
W=/tmp/bench71379578
cat > "$W/bin/run-test" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
echo "STARTED nonce=00000000000000000000000000000000 id=0000 host=10.66.71.1 port=32768"
echo "ANSWER bench71379578-ready nonce=00000000000000000000000000000000"
echo DONE
EOF
chmod +x "$W/bin/run-test"
"$W/bin/run-test"
